title: The Harness Ontology
subtitle: A model answers. A harness acts.

segments.text: A model can answer. But can it act?
Answering is not acting. A model proposes; a harness governs the act.
A bounded envelope: a runtime, inputs and outputs, an authority, a receipt, and a fallback. The plugin only packages it.
How many harnesses does this studio carry?
Nine: voice, media, control, physics, viewport, robot, publish, course, and ledger. A Mixture of Harnesses.
The human. Every harness is rooted at HUMAN ROOT, and each action writes a receipt to the unified hash chain. Mechanism plus authority plus receipt equals opensourceware.
So the proof is public, and a failed runtime still records how it degraded.
A model answers. A harness acts. A receipt proves it.
